blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — Residents of Santa Lucia now have better access to primary healthcare services following the inauguration of a new Super Health Center in Barangay Vical, Santa Lucia town. In a statement on Friday (Nov. 13), the Department of Health (DOH)-Ilocos Region said it led the opening of the center on Oct. 28. The project is in partnership with the municipal government of Santa Lucia and the provincial government of Ilocos Sur. The facility is expected to boost the municipality’s delivery of basic health services by providing residents with a more accessible place for medical consultations, preventive care […]...
